[1/3] Plan: habit evidence plus slip-tolerant recovery nudge

impact_assessment.why: Habit strength improves with intervention (SMD 0.69, 39685110) but takes ~2 months; single misses do not reset formation (Lally 2009); habit correlates with frequency at r=0.46 (21626256). The app punishes nothing but also says nothing after a slip
impact_assessment.benefits: a missed day gets a warm, evidence-true response instead of silence; habit horizon (~2 months) sets honest expectations
impact_assessment.risks: contract: display-only derivation from history; dependency: none new; concurrency: n/a; state: no new keys
impact_assessment.mitigation: pure date logic over stored sessions; copy gain-framed and lint-checked; no streak penalty anywhere
